data.name: Layout_EngineDesc
data.value: Merges OCR words into paragraphs using distance thresholds

data.name: Layout_WordGapThreshold_Desc
data.value: Maximum gap between words (% of word height) to merge into a line

data.name: Layout_BaselineDriftTolerance_Desc
data.value: Maximum vertical drift of word centers (% of word height) to merge into a line

data.name: Layout_LineSpacingThreshold_Desc
data.value: Maximum vertical distance between line centers (% of word height) to merge into a paragraph

data.name: Layout_LeftEdgeAlignmentTolerance_Desc
data.value: Maximum horizontal offset of left edges (% of word height) to merge into a paragraph

data.name: Layout_FirstLineIndentTolerance_Desc
data.value: Maximum extra indentation of the first line (% of word height)

data.name: Layout_CenterAlignment_Desc
data.value: Also merge lines if their horizontal centers align

data.name: Layout_FontSizeTolerance_Desc
data.value: Max height difference (% of line height) between lines before splitting paragraphs

data.name: Layout_EnableStabilization_Desc
data.value: Match paragraphs to the previous frame to reduce OCR flicker; hold brand-new text and upgrades until stable; ghost short unmatched blocks one frame

data.name: Layout_CenterThresholdXPercent_Desc
data.value: Max horizontal paragraph-center drift (% of average line height) to match the previous frame

data.name: Layout_CenterThresholdYPercent_Desc
data.value: Max vertical paragraph-center drift (% of average line height) to match the previous frame

data.name: Layout_LevenshteinThreshold_Desc
data.value: Max Levenshtein distance (% of longer text) to treat paragraphs as the same

data.name: Layout_MinLength
data.value: Min text length for fuzzy match

data.name: Layout_MinLength_Desc
data.value: Shorter texts require an exact match to pair with the previous frame

data.name: Layout_ParagraphMergeHysteresisPercent_Desc
data.value: Bias line-to-paragraph merging toward the previous frame's structure (100 = off, 120 = ±20% tolerances)

data.name: Layout_WordFilters_Desc
data.value: Filter OCR words before lines are built

data.name: Layout_LineFilters_Desc
data.value: Filter lines before paragraphs are built
